args.text: First look: a red popcorn machine in the middle with a big ring around it. The ring is red on the left top, then a bright white segment on the lower left, the rest pale blue with arrows going clockwise. Looks like a timing ring - maybe tap when something hits the white zone? A hand/finger icon on the machine suggests tapping it. Coin counter 0 at the top. Bottom card: a pot icon, 30 coins, +10 > +16 with an up arrow - an upgrade I can't afford yet. Top: back, sound, restart. A smoke puff above the machine - burning? I expect tapping the machine pops popcorn and earns coins, maybe better if timed with the white zone.

One tap gave 1 coin, a gray needle appeared at the top of the ring then vanished. Nothing moves on its own. The ring colors: blue (with clockwise arrows), then yellow zone lower-left, then red to the top, smoke at top. Guess: holding heats the machine and the needle travels clockwise; let go in the yellow zone for a good pop, red = burnt. Trying a hold.

Yes! Holding makes a yellow dot run clockwise around the ring and kernels heat up (flames under the machine). Held 2 s: dot was at the yellow/red edge, release mark landed in red, got +3 coins (1->4). So I should let go a bit earlier, in the yellow. Trying 1.6 s.

Got it! 1.3 s hold landed the release mark right in the middle of the yellow: +10 coins (9->19). 1.6 s = edge, +5. 2 s = red, +3. The bottom card is filling with yellow - it's showing how close I am to the 30-coin upgrade, which probably raises +10 to +16 per perfect pop. Nice feedback. Doing it again.

34 coins. The bottom card lit up solid yellow, the arrow and +16 turned red - clearly saying 'you can buy now'. Same 1.3 s hold earlier only gave +5, so my timing (or the phone's) wobbles; 1.15 s landed at the start of yellow for +10. Buying the upgrade now.

Bought it: coins 34->4, the machine got a striped awning with bunting and grew bigger - satisfying visual reward. Next upgrade: 54 coins, +16 -> +26, icon is now a cart on wheels. The ring flashes white when idle, I guess that's the 'ready' hint. Let's see if a perfect pop now gives 16.

Perfect pop now gives +16 (4->20), confirmed. Release marks stay on the ring so I can see where I let go - helpful for correcting. Loop is clear now: hold, release in yellow, save up, upgrade. Racing to 54.
Two perfect pops in a row, 52 coins - argh, 2 short of 54. Popcorn is now spilling out all over the floor around the machine, which looks great. One more pop then upgrade.
Upgraded again (68->14): the machine is now a cart on wheels, bigger, popcorn overflowing. Next: 97 coins, +26 -> +40. Each step looks a little grander. One last pop before time runs out.
